---
title: "Trees"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(quanteda)
library(Matrix)
library(ggraph)
library(igraph)
```

Data Load:

```{r}
hobbit <- read.csv(here("Hobbit_Clean.csv"))
txt <- hobbit$text
```

```{r}
toks <- tokens(txt, remove_punct = TRUE, remove_numbers = TRUE) |>
  tokens_tolower() |>
  tokens_remove(stopwords("en"))

# Keep only frequent words so the matrix stays manageable
dfmat <- dfm(toks) |> dfm_trim(min_termfreq = 20)
top   <- names(topfeatures(dfmat, 200))

# Co-occurrence within a sliding window
fcmat <- fcm(toks, context = "window", window = 5, tri = FALSE)
fcmat <- fcmat[top, top]

# PPMI weighting (much better than raw counts)
m   <- as(fcmat, "dgCMatrix")
tot <- sum(m); rs <- rowSums(m); cs <- colSums(m)
pmi <- log((m * tot) / outer(rs, cs))
pmi[!is.finite(pmi) | pmi < 0] <- 0

# Cosine distance -> hierarchical clustering
sim <- as.matrix(pmi); sim <- sim / sqrt(rowSums(sim^2) + 1e-9)
d   <- as.dist(1 - sim %*% t(sim))
hc  <- hclust(d, method = "ward.D2")
```

```{r}
# Plot as a circular dendrogram
dend <- as.dendrogram(hc)

p <- ggraph(dend, layout = "dendrogram", circular = TRUE) +
  geom_edge_diagonal(alpha = 0.4)

# Leaf positions -> rotation angle for each label
lab <- subset(p$data, leaf)
lab$angle <- atan2(lab$y, lab$x) * 180 / pi
flip      <- lab$angle > 90 | lab$angle < -90
lab$angle <- ifelse(flip, lab$angle + 180, lab$angle)
lab$hjust <- ifelse(flip, 1, 0)

lim <- max(sqrt(lab$x^2 + lab$y^2)) * 1.4   # room for the labels

p +
  geom_text(data = lab,
            aes(x = x * 1.03, y = y * 1.03, label = label,
                angle = angle, hjust = hjust),
            size = 2.0) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim)) +
  theme_void()
```
